notes.title: Robot Gentleman announces their new game: 60 Seconds! Souper Scavenger.
notes.notes:
[p]All you soup lovers, this is not a drill!  Robot Gentleman, creators of the dark comedy postapocalyptic series 60!, invite you to visit the atomic wasteland once again in [i][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3197360/60_Seconds_Souper_Scavenger/"]60 Seconds! Souper Scavenger[/url][/u][/i]. Watch the teaser trailer and prepare for the endless soup scavenge run! And plenty of fun![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/7Wv5aMhRBPw"][/dynamiclink]The McDoodle family survived the nuclear apocalypse in the safety of their fallout shelter. But their troubles are far from over. Supplies are running low, and soup is all but gone. Someone has to step up and venture into the hostile wasteland to scavenge.[/p][p]How about... Mary Jane?[/p][list][*][p]RUN & JUMP your way through the procedurally generated wasteland. No one can stop you. But they will try.[/p][/*][*][p]SCAVENGE soup, supplies, and even grab friends to join your endless run (disclaimer: until you perish).[/p][/*][*][p]SURVIVE the deadly hazards of the wasteland. Raiders, ill-parked bicycles, remains of the collapsed civilization, mutant marathons, and many more.[/p][/*][*][p]VISIT all the incredible postapocalyptic, only ever so slightly radioactive locations, and enjoy the sights. And of course, all the soup you can find there![/p][/*][*][p]RUN AGAIN and again, because it will take more than one try to stock that fallout shelter of yours.
[/p][/*][/list][p]No time to waste! Run, Mary Jane, run![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3197360/60_Seconds_Souper_Scavenger/"][/dynamiclink]
[i]60 Seconds! Souper Scavenger[/i] will give you a chance to experience what scavenging in the atomic wasteland really feels like. This one of a kind endless runner will provide crazy replayability, gorgeous hand-drawn animations, weird environments to perish in, and of course plenty of soup. It is also Robot Gentleman's first title to be developed with the open-source Godot game engine.[/p][p]Remember: it's all about SOUP.[/p][p][/p][p]Don’t ever miss out on news from Robot Gentleman! Make sure you’re [u][url="https://robotgentleman.com/#contact"]subscribed to the studio's newsletter[/url][/u], follow the [u][url="https://linktr.ee/robotgentleman"]studio's social channels[/url][/u], and join our [u][url="https://discord.gg/UvjzDFwr"]Discord server[/url][/u]![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Happy 10th Anniversary, 60 Seconds! 10 years of soup, insanity, and roaches
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35389931/22a4999d4286170f1d3fe0cce6503929bcda2a5d.png[/img]

Ten years ago, we launched a small, strange game about surviving the unthinkable, and somehow, it found a place in your hearts. 60 Seconds! was started with love, but our players are the ones who breathed life into it, helping shape the game through every blind faith decision, failed run, and many fantastically crazy endings.

We've watched the 60 Seconds! community grow, share incredible fan theories, impressive speedruns, beautiful art, infectious laughter, and your love for all these characters for an entire decade. That is no little feat.

Join us as we celebrate these 10 years of 60 Seconds! We're 3 days away from our livestream on Steam. There are plenty of surprises and secrets ready to enjoy in the coming weeks. And of course, enjoy the sale on Steam!

notes.title: 60 Seconds! 7th Anniversary Sale is here!
notes.notes:
It has already been seven years under the cozy shield of our nuclear bunker. We ate countless cans of soup and drank stashes of bottles of water, watched our Mary Jane, Sharikov and Pancake grow, and witnessed the rise of Timmy.

And once again, the 25th of May - the day when 60 Seconds! was released - is upon us.

[previewyoutube=Dxb8BuxntlA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Join us in celebrating the 7th anniversary of the 60 Seconds! and on the eve of the 25th of May scavenge 60 Seconds! Reatomized at an atomic rate of 50% off (while soup supplies last!).[/b]

Those 2555 days (!!!) would have not been possible without you and your support. Thank you so much for being here with us, but most of all - thank you for helping the one-of-a-kind suburban American family survive the nuclear wasteland.

May the soup be with you!
the Robots of Robot Gentleman

notes.title: Never mind the ladder! 60 Seconds! Reatomized drops straight down to your shelters on July 25th!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35389931/7e229b39e83532cfbe5ce101b3651bc5506f8757.jpg[/img]

That’s right, there’s not much time left to prepare, survivors! Make sure you’ve got your soup and family handy [b]next Thursday, July 25th[/b], when 60 Seconds! Reatomized launches. Add the game to your wishlist now if you don’t want to miss the release and get invaded by mutant roaches.

The trailer’s here, too! Watch it here: https://youtu.be/xqC3Bu94eU8

Oh, and remember! Every owner of the original 60 Seconds! on Steam will get their Steam copy of the Reatomized edition for absolutely FREE! If you don’t want to miss out on that, make sure you’ve got the original in your library before release day. 

See you soon on the wasteland!
